integrity: Reproducible exact face enumeration, complete acyclic discrete-Morse matching and signed Morse cellular boundary calculation are included. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy type for the 24-vertex small rhombicuboctahedral graph only. No extension to other uniform polyhedra or all graph families is claimed; equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Integral sphere-wedge homotopy of the small rhombicuboctahedral independence complex
